Introduction: The Book of Gates of Righteousness [Sefer Sha'arei Tzedek] authored by the wise Rabbi Yosef ben Karnitol, son of the honorable Rabbi Avraham, son of R.I.T., the author of the book Gates of Light [Sha'arei Orah]; in righteousness and in justice is his work, to enter into the innermost palace of the Divine Kabbalah, and it shall be righteousness for us when we bring to light the secrets of wisdom. Gates of Righteousness. After light has shone upon us in the book Gates of Light, which has already been printed. And it shall be accounted to us as righteousness. And in righteousness you shall behold His face. For you will understand and know the secret of Kabbalah. As "one who comes to purify himself, they open [the way] for him." And the gates have not been locked. All of them are set upon the earth, and its top reaches unto heaven, and the Work of the Chariot [Ma'aseh Merkavah]. Lift up your heads, O ye gates. And righteousness, righteousness shall you pursue. Turn it over and turn it over, for everything is in it. Enter into His gates with thanksgiving. Then the tongue will sing. Open to me the gates of righteousness; I will enter into them, I will praise the Lord.

You have asked of me, friend of my soul, to illuminate one of the inner attainments, to know which way the light dwells concerning the matter of the Ten Sefirot. And behold, I have lifted up your face [granted your request] to fulfill your desires, and may God favor you. The beginning of the path by which a person enters into the unity of the Creator, blessed be He, is the knowledge of the gate. For do you not know that if a person wishes to see the face of the King, and toils for several days, and after the toil he did not merit to know the location of the gate, what benefit is there in all the toil that he toiled and the entire way that he walked, when he does not know the gate through which to enter to see the face of the King? And in this manner are all those who trouble themselves to enter the Orchard [Pardes], but they do not know and they do not understand, and in darkness they walk, and there is no benefit in their labor. Therefore, I saw fit to illuminate a path before you in the way by which you shall go, and the gate through which you shall enter, and then you will be desired and accepted before Hashem, blessed be He, and you will be among those who merit to behold the pleasantness of Hashem and to visit in His palace.
text: "This is the gate of Hashem; the righteous shall enter through it." Know that Hashem, blessed be He, chose Israel when He separated all the languages in the Generation of the Division, each man according to his language, according to their families, in their nations. And He gave to each and every nation a minister and ruler over them, and He likewise gave to each nation its portion of the earth. And in this manner, the nations and the lands were singled out, each one to a known minister. And concerning this it is said: "From these the islands of the nations were separated in their lands, each man according to his language, according to their families, in their nations." And this is the secret of the matter of the Division [HaPalagah]. And all seventy nations remained delivered into the hands of seventy ministers above, and those seventy ministers surround the outside of the Throne of Glory, and they are what are called the secret of the shells [Klipot], and within them is grasped the secret of the uncircumcision [Orlah]. And when Abraham our father, peace be upon him, came in that category in which he was, he gave a place of grasping for the crowns that were on the right side through Ishmael—an analogy like the thread that connects pieces of cloth. And concerning this it is said: "And as for Ishmael, I have heard you," and this is the secret of: "And his hand shall be against every man, and every man's hand against him," and "over the face of all his brethren shall he dwell." And when Isaac came in that category in which he was, he gave a place of grasping for the crowns that were on the left side through Esau—an analogy like the thread we mentioned above. And concerning this it is said: "The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, etc." You find yourself learning that Ishmael and Esau are the secret of the grasping of the seventy crowns around the Chariot [Merkavah], and all of them are called outer shells and uncircumcision, and in Scripture they are called "outside" [chutzot], as it is said: "While as yet He had not made the earth, nor the outside [chutzot]." And this is the secret of: "And He brought him outside [hachutzah]," and "The wife of the dead shall not be married outside [hachutzah]." And when Jacob our father, peace be upon him, came, he stood in the middle: Abraham on the right side, Isaac on the left side, and Jacob in the middle. And the secret is: "And Jacob was a wholesome man, dwelling in tents." It is found that Abraham and Isaac rectified the entire Chariot, outer and inner. They rectified the inner, which is grasped in Jacob, in the Beauty [Tiferet], in the middle line. And they rectified the outer, which is the seventy crowns grasped in YHWH, blessed be He, through Ishmael and Esau. It is found that when Jacob came, he was clean without dross, and therefore he is in the middle. And this is the secret of what he said [on his deathbed]: "Perhaps, Heaven forbid, there is a defect in my bed, like Abraham from whom issued Ishmael, and like Isaac from whom issued Esau?" They all opened [their mouths] and said: "Hear, O Israel, etc." It is found that Jacob and his sons are grasped in the middle line, which is called the inner point and the inner palace. And this inner palace is what is called the middle line; it is what is called the name YHWH, blessed be He, and it is in the middle, and seventy crowns surround it. This is what is said in the Book of Formation [Sefer Yetzirah]: "The holy palace is directed precisely in the middle." And this is the secret of "earth and outside" that we mentioned above, and this is the place called the middle line, and we need to know in what place and through which gate one enters into it.

And we say, know that since the seventy nations were divided into seventy crowns—each nation and its land to a known minister—and the Name, blessed be He, found no portion in any of them, because He is pure and they are all impure, and it is written: "You are of eyes too pure to behold evil." And concerning this it is said: "And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east [mi-kedem]," they certainly journeyed and separated themselves from the Ancient One [Kedmono] of the world. And the Name had no portion in all the nations and in all the lands, because they were all impure until Jacob came, who is precisely aligned between Abraham and Isaac; he is the portion for YHWH, blessed be He. For YHWH, blessed be He, dwells in the inner palace, and the ministers surround His throne, like the imagery of the fruit and the shells [klipot]. And the great secret that encompasses everything: "It is better to take refuge in YHWH than to trust in man. It is better to take refuge in YHWH than to trust in princes, etc." "In the name of YHWH, for I will cut them off. They compassed me about, yea, they compassed me about; in the name of YHWH, for I will cut them off. They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns; in the name of YHWH, for I will cut them off." He said "I will cut them off" three times, and "they compassed me about / they compassed me" four times. And this is the secret of the four barriers that Ezekiel saw and that Elijah saw, and the fourth was thin. And behold, I am hinting: The casing that is called the outer throne is called Adam [man], and the inner throne is called ADNY. And the secret of these and those: "When you come into the land, etc., then you shall count its fruit as forbidden [uncircumcised]..." (The secret is 3 times 70, which equals 210 [RDU]). "Three years it shall be [forbidden] unto you... and in the fourth year... all the fruit thereof shall be holy... and in the fifth year you shall eat of the fruit thereof, etc." And when you merit to understand what we have written, you will attain the secret of "earth and outside," and you will attain "It is better to take refuge in YHWH than to trust in princes." And the secret is hinted at: "And upon the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man [Adam]." And the secret: "When a plague of leprosy is in a man [Adam], then he shall be brought unto the priest." Woe to mankind for the humiliation of this verse! And concerning this it is said: "The righteous is taken away from the evil to come." And this is what the Torah said: "This is the Torah: when a man [Adam] dies in a tent, etc."

And let us return to the intent of the verse: "This is the gate of YHWH; the righteous shall enter through it." That is to say, we must seek the gate through which one enters to YHWH, blessed be He, since four barriers surround His palace.

And we say, since Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob came, they rectified all the Chariots [Merkavot], the upper ones and the lower outer ones: the outer ones on the outside, and the inner one on the inside. And it is found that Abraham and Isaac bound the outer Chariot on the outside through Ishmael and Esau, and the inner Chariot was bound through Jacob. And when Jacob came—complete, without a speck or blemish, refined sevenfold, refined through Seth, Noah, Shem, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob who is the seventh—concerning them it is said: "As silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times." And it is found that his bed was complete; therefore, the Name chose him, for he is the middle line, and He combined the pure with the pure, and rested the pure upon the pure. And then YHWH found for Himself a portion among the creations, and the sign is: "For Jah [YH] has chosen Jacob unto Himself, and Israel for His peculiar treasure." And this is His portion that fell to Him in all the world, and this is the secret of: "For the portion of YHWH is His people; Jacob is the lot of His inheritance, etc." And the secret of: "And He brought him outside, etc." "He found him in a desert land..." "YHWH alone did lead him, etc." And since He chose Jacob, who is middlemost in the middle line, Jacob became a complete throne for the Name, blessed be He, for Abraham and Isaac were only called thrones of the limbs, and the sign is: "The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob." And concerning this it is said: "You have avouched YHWH this day... and YHWH has avouched you." And the secret is the twelve tribes, corresponding to the twelve names that are permuted from the Unique Name, blessed be He, and the verse proclaims and says: "All these are the twelve tribes of Israel; and this is it that their father spoke unto them, and blessed them." And then Jacob became a complete throne for the Chariot—that is to say, a throne of the body and not a throne of the earth, for the Shechinah did not dwell below until the fourth leg arrived (meaning, in permanent rest), but only temporarily, even in the days of Moses our teacher, peace be upon him. And concerning this it is said: "When the ram's horn sounds long, they shall come up to the mount."

And after you have known this, know that just as Hashem [Y'] chose Jacob from among the other nations, so He chose Zion from among the lands, to dwell in Jerusalem from among the places. And just as there fell to each and every minister a portion during the Generation of the Division from among the nations and the lands, so did the portion of Hashem [Y"Y], blessed be He, ascend: from among the nations, Jacob; and from among the lands, the Land of Israel; and from among the places, Jerusalem. Concerning this it is said: "For Your name is called upon Your city and upon Your people." And just as Jacob is in the middle of the Patriarchs, so Jerusalem is in the middle of the inhabited world. And concerning this it is said: "This is Jerusalem; I have set her in the midst of the nations, and countries are round about her." It is found that the secret of "earth and outside" is explained. And concerning this it is said: "You have avouched YHWH this day, and YHWH has avouched you." You find yourself learning the secret of "And He brought him outside"—for Abraham had no apparent root and place of grasping except in the externality and in the shells [klipot] called uncircumcision [orlah]; therefore, the beginning of circumcision was for Abraham, the secret of circumcision. And when Abraham was uprooted from the place of his planting, the Holy One, blessed be He, returned and planted him in an inner place, and the sign is: "And I took your father Abraham from beyond the river, etc." And guard this great principle, for it is an inner secret from the chambers of the Torah.

And after you have known this, know that YHWH, blessed be His name—the Great YHWH, may He be blessed—is named upon Jacob. And since Jacob inherited the inheritance of the Great YHWH, blessed be He, YHWH made known to Jacob through which gate he should enter when he needs to enter into His chambers—which is not the case for any other nation or language. And concerning this it is said: "He declares His words unto Jacob, His statutes and His ordinances unto Israel. He has not dealt so [with any nation, etc.]." And from where do we know that the Name, blessed be He, made known to Jacob to come to the gate through which he should enter His palaces? It is written: "And he lighted upon the place, and tarried there all night... and he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth." He knew the kingship of YHWH, blessed be He, but he did not know through which gate he should enter it; so the Holy One, blessed be He, showed him the path of entry. From where [is this derived]? As it is written: "And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, etc., and behold, YHWH stood above it, and He said..." Behold, he saw the gate through which he would enter to the ladder, concerning which it is written: "and behold, YHWH stood above it." And what is written after it? "And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said: 'Surely YHWH is in this place... and this is the gate of heaven.'" And behold, Jacob merited to attain the gate through which they enter into the courts of YHWH, as it is written: "This is the gate of YHWH; the righteous shall enter through it." And since he attained this gate, he merited to enter into the twelve diagonal boundaries, which are the secret of the upper and lower world. And everything is grasped within the secret of the Thirteen Attributes by which the Torah is expounded, and the secret of the twelve tribes which are thirteen, and the secret of the twelve months which are thirteen within the secret of the leap year [the intercalation].

And know that when Jacob came and attained the location of the gate, he ascended to the height of the ladder—which Abraham and Isaac did not merit and did not attain, for Abraham and Isaac only reached as far as the location of the shoulders, and this is the secret of: "and underneath are the everlasting arms," and they did not ascend further. And were it not for this, the seed of Jacob would have no standing among the nations, between Ishmael and Esau. And those shoulders are called the high places of the earth [bamtei aretz]. And the great secret: "the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac"; but above them, "and the God of Jacob"—the middle line that ascends until it grasps the Crown [Keter]. "This your stature is like to a palm tree," but above, "and your breasts to clusters of grapes." "He made him ride on the high places of the earth [bamtei aretz]..." "and you shall tread upon their high places." "The eternal God is a dwelling-place, and underneath are the everlasting arms; and He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said: 'Destroy!' And Israel dwells in safety, the fountain [eye] of Jacob alone"—and not the fountain [eye] of Abraham and Isaac, because Abraham and Isaac are the arms, and they are "underneath," because within them Ishmael, Esau, and the seventy crowns are grasped. But Jacob, who merited to attain the gate and to ascend by way of the ladder, and was grasped in the middle line unto the height of the ascension, unto the Infinite [Ein Sof] by way of the neck—therefore, regarding Abraham and Isaac it is written with boundaries: "Lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward," and likewise with Isaac; but regarding Jacob: "And you shall spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south," and it is an inheritance without boundaries [metzarim]. And because no minister of all the ministers of the nations ascends to that place, concerning this it is said: "For Jah [YH] has chosen Jacob unto Himself"—certainly—"and Israel for His peculiar treasure." And it is written: "Then shall you delight yourself in YHWH"—certainly—"and I will cause you to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father"—the heritage of Jacob, and not the heritage of Abraham and Isaac.

And after we have made known to you these principles, know that the secret of this gate, which Jacob merited and attained, is the secret of the tenth Sefirah, which is called Shechinah [the Divine Presence], and the sign is: "And Israel dwells in safety, the fountain [eye] of Jacob alone." And when Jacob attained this gate, which is the foundation of the Shechinah called Tzedek [Righteousness], then the Scripture proclaims and says: "Open to me the gates of righteousness [tzedek]; I will enter into them, I will praise Jah [YH], etc.", for "Jah [YH] has chosen Jacob unto Himself." And up to which place shall I enter? Until the place called the neck: "I will enter into them, I will praise Jah [YH]," for "Jah [YH] has chosen Jacob unto Himself." And this is the secret of: "As for me, in righteousness [b'tzedek] I shall behold Your face"—that is to say, since I have merited to find the gate, I shall then enter to see the face of the King.

And after you have known this, know that this gate, through which they enter to attain and to see the face of the King, may He be blessed, is the secret of the unity of our Creator, may He be blessed. And it is the secret of the blessing [berachah] that the Name, blessed be He, delivered to Abraham, because all types of abundance and emanation that are drawn down from the Upper Eden, which is called Keter [Crown], by way of the Tiferet [Beauty], which is called Nahar [River]—all of them enter into the tenth pool [bereichah], which is the secret of Malchut [Kingship]. And concerning this it is written: "the wells of Abraham and Isaac." And Hashem, blessed be He, delivered this pool [bereichah] to Abraham, so that all the nations should be blessed through it; and this is what He said: "And I will make of you a great nation, etc., and you shall be a blessing [berachah]." What is "and you shall be a blessing"? That is to say: in you I cause the Shechinah to dwell, which is the pool [bereichah], and it is the tenth Sefirah, which receives abundance from the nine illuminating mirrors [aspeklariot]. And even though He delivered the pool to Abraham, He did not deliver the gate to him, and likewise to Isaac, because there was within them the dross of Ishmael and Esau. But Jacob, who had no dross within him—He delivered the gate to him, just as we have explained. And that which Hashem, blessed be He, said to Abraham: "And in you shall all the families of the earth be blessed," everything is explained; for seventy families are grasped in Abraham and Isaac, from the language of grafting [havrachah] and interlocking [harkavah]. And were it not for Abraham and Isaac, the seventy nations would have no grasping within the Chariot [Merkavah], and this is the secret of the seventy bulls of the Festival [Sukkot].

And after you have known this, know that regarding the gate called Tzedek [Righteousness]—even though Abraham inherited the Sefirah, he did not inherit the gate until Jacob came. And concerning this gate, it is said of Abraham: "Who raised up one from the east, whom righteousness [tzedek] meets at his foot?" And this is the secret of the Gates of Righteousness.

And know that from the time Jacob knew the gate and took the key, no creature in the world can enter unto the Name, blessed be He, except through Jacob and his sons—that is to say, until they convert and are circumcised, and enter under the wings of the Shechinah. And through which gate shall they enter? Through the Gates of Righteousness [Sha'arei Tzedek]. And concerning this, the true converts are called converts of righteousness [gerei tzedek]—that is to say, the converts enter into the palace of YHWH, blessed be He, by way of the Gate of Righteousness. And guard this principle, because since Abraham inherited the Sefirah of Tzedek, all converts are called after his name, gerei tzedek, and the secret of "and [all the families of the earth] shall be blessed [venivrechu] in you" is that they are literally grafted [nivrechu].

And after you have known this, we need to illuminate a path before you within this Sefirah, which is called "the gate of YHWH." And we say that not every person is worthy to enter through a gate such as this as a permanent fixture, but rather as a temporary entry, to enter and to depart; but he shall not remain always as a permanent dwelling within. Even Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, did not merit to remain always within, but rather they would enter and depart. And a permanent dwelling within this gate did not remain for anyone, except for Moses our teacher, peace be upon him, alone. And concerning this it is said: "Go say to them: 'Return to your tents.' But as for you, stand here by Me." And this is what they [the Sages] said: "All the prophets looked through a mirror that is not polished, but Moses looked through a polished mirror." And the reason is because he entered inward from this gate, and he entered with permission and established his dwelling there. And the secret is: "And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of meeting, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of YHWH filled the tabernacle." And YHWH, blessed be He, called him, and he entered with permission; and concerning this it is said: "And He called unto Moses, and YHWH spoke unto him out of the tent of meeting," and it is written: "But as for you, stand here by Me." And since he established his dwelling there, he did not cease, and concerning this it is said: "Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth." And because Moses entered inward from the gate and established his dwelling there, he would always see through the polished mirror. But the rest of the prophets, whose dwelling was not permanent inward from the gate but only temporary, would look outside the gatehouse, and they would see behind the tenth barrier—and that is the mirror that is not polished. And this is the secret of: "Hear now My words: If there be a prophet among you, etc. My servant Moses is not so; he is trusted in all My house." In all My house, literally—for he entered and established his dwelling inward from the gate, and he was found trusted with all the property of the King, which are the chambers called the house of the King: "he is trusted in all My house."

And after you have known this, know that regarding this attribute called Sha'arei Tzedek [Gates of Righteousness], which Jacob inherited, he delivered all of its keys into the hands of his sons. And this gate has thirteen keys: twelve for the twelve chambers, and the inner key, which is the completion of the thirteen, he delivered to Levi. And this is the secret of the Priestly Blessing, for from there the blessings spread out and go forth to the twelve chambers of the twelve keys that belong to each and every tribe. And this is the secret of: "All these are the twelve tribes of Israel; and this is it that their father spoke unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them." And when Moses our teacher, peace be upon him, came and blessed Israel, he made known that the key which encompasses all keys is delivered into the hand of the tribe of Levi, just as he said: "And of Levi he said: Your Thummim and Your Urim be with Your holy one"—the secret of the Urim and Thummim is the secret of all the gates. And behold, I am hinting at the secret of light [orah] and "And Jacob was a wholesome [tam] man." Therefore, He said in the Torah: "Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying: In this wise you shall bless the children of Israel... and they shall put My name upon the children of Israel, and I will bless them." And therefore the Scripture said: "Wherefore Levi has no portion nor inheritance with his brethren; YHWH is his inheritance." And guard this great principle, for the Name, blessed be He, is certainly his inheritance.

And after we have made known to you this, know that the Tent of Meeting [Ohel Moed]—which is the secret of the Shechinah that Jacob inherited, and it is his portion and his inheritance—he bequeathed it to his sons as an inheritance. And concerning this it is said: "And I will set My tabernacle among you... and I will be your God." And it is written: "Who dwells with them in the midst of their uncleanness"—literally. Happy is the people that is in such a case; happy is the people whose God is YHWH.

And behold, this attribute has one hundred corners, and for each and every corner there is a receptacle, and from each and every corner flow springs of blessing to the world. And from there Isaac our father, peace be upon him, drew the one hundred kinds of blessings through which he became wealthy. And concerning this it is said: "And Isaac sowed in that land, and found in the same year a hundredfold [literally, one hundred gates]"—literally—"and YHWH blessed him." And therefore: "And the man waxed great, etc." And therefore the Philistines and kings envied him because of the abundance of his blessings. And these one hundred gates that Isaac found, through which he was blessed, are one hundred gates and springs around the Gates of Righteousness [Sha'arei Tzedek], from which go forth blessing, abundance, and emanation to all creations by means of Israel. And therefore you will find in the Tent of Meeting [Ohel Moed] one hundred sockets: "for the hundred talents, a talent for a socket." And there is not a single socket among all of them that did not have within it a receptacle for a pillar. The foundation of the pillars is known within the hooks, and the sign is: "the hooks [vavei] of the pillars," and the secret is the middle line, and the God of Jacob. And because this is the path by which each and every one of Israel is blessed with one hundred kinds of blessings and kinds of abundance and emanation, each one of Israel must bless one hundred blessings every day. That is to say, each and every blessing has a spring and a source from which it is flowed and emanated. And if, Heaven forbid, a person lacks one of the one hundred blessings each day, he blemishes the entire Torah as a whole, and is found ruining all the channels. And your sign is: Nefesh [Soul], Ruach [Spirit], and Neshamah [Highest Soul]; Yisrael [Israelite], Levi [Levite], Kohen [Priest]. And the secret: "And unto the children of Levi, behold, I have given all the tithe in Israel for an inheritance, in return for their service, etc." And it is written: "Moreover you shall speak unto the Levites, and say unto them: When you take of the children of Israel the tithe... then you shall set apart of it a gift for YHWH, even a tithe of the tithe." It is found that the Israelite gives to the Levite ten out of every hundred, and the Levite gives to the Priest one out of every ten. If there is no hundred for the Israelite, there is no ten for the Levite; if there is no ten for the Levite, there is no one for the Priest, and the bundle is separated, and there is no longer a vessel to empty into. And in this manner, if the Nefesh does not bless one hundred blessings every day, ten from the tithe will not reach the Ruach. And when the Ruach does not receive ten, one will not reach the Neshamah. And behold, we are obligated every day to bind the Nefesh to the Ruach, and the Ruach to the Neshamah, and the Neshamah cleaves to YHWH, blessed be He. And the secret: "Yet the soul [nefesh] of my lord shall be bound in the bundle of life with YHWH your God." And this is the secret of: "Bless YHWH, O my soul [nafshi]," and it is written: "Let everything that has breath [heneshamah] praise Jah [YH]." And in this manner we say that any person who does not complete one hundred blessings every day blemishes his form and cuts down the plantings of his soul, and woe to him for his deficiency! And he does not enter into the Gates of Righteousness [Sha'arei Tzedek], because the sockets for the pillars are not arranged, and the Tent is not spread out according to order; therefore, the Shechinah does not dwell upon a blemished thing. And this is the secret of: "A tent that shall not be removed [literally, yitz'an, via those who are loaded/exiled], the stakes thereof shall never be plucked up, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken." It is found that anyone who completes one hundred blessings, it is as if he spreads out a tent and fixes it upon one hundred sockets, and then he is blessed with one hundred blessings. And because the one hundred blessings correspond to the one hundred sockets for the one hundred talents, and all of them are bored with a completely open hole, it is found that one hundred windows of light are opened opposite the one hundred blessings. And he who knows this knows the secret of the heave-offering [terumah] and the secret of Tari [two] out of a hundred, for if there is no hundred, there are no two from the tithes.

And after we have explained this, know that this gate is called everywhere in the Torah—ADNY. And it is the palace of YHWH, blessed be He, and therefore He is always named within it, for YHWH dwells in His house always; and understand this very well. And because this Sefirah corresponds to the earth, its secret is: "The man, the lord [adonei] of [the land], spoke, etc." And because the first man [Adam] caused [a blemish] and it was withdrawn from below, until Noah came and brought it back for a single hour and no more, it was then said: "Noah was a righteous [tzaddik] man, wholesome in his generations; Noah walked with God, etc." And this is the secret for which he was named Noah, from the language of "The spirit of Elijah rested [nachah] upon Elisha," "And he called his name Noah, saying: 'This same shall comfort us [yenachamenu], etc.,'" "But Noah found grace in the eyes of YHWH," "And Noah built an altar... and YHWH smelled the sweet savor [the savor of rest—hanichoach], and YHWH said in His heart: 'I will not again, etc.'" All of this was done, yet nevertheless, [the earth] was not blessed until Abraham came and designated for them the sign of the places of blessings: "And he built there an altar unto YHWH, and called upon the name of YHWH." And Abraham our father, peace be upon him, rectified himself and made his right side a throne for the Chariot, and this attribute dwelt upon him; therefore it is said: "and you shall be a blessing." And when he entered into the land, he designated places for the Shechinah and began to call upon the name of YHWH because of the land, which is its portion. And concerning this they [the Sages], of blessed memory, said: "'And cause Your face to shine upon Your sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord's [ADNY] sake'—for the sake of the one who called You Master [Adon]," and that is Abraham our father, peace be upon him. And when you understand these matters, several gates of light [sha'arei orah] will open before you, and you will know and comprehend from the source of the matter. And through it, you will see that in every place you find the name YHWH written in the Torah, it is read as ADNY, because it is the secret of the tenth Sefirah, and it is the mirror that does not illuminate. And it is in great need of that which is above it. Therefore, you will find that Abraham rectified a place for it, like one who holds onto a matter; however, a permanent dwelling was not fixed in the ground until the fourth leg arrived. And concerning that hour it was said: "This is my resting-place for ever and ever; here will I dwell, for I have desired it," which is the secret of: "For Your name is called upon Your city and upon Your people"; and understand this very well.

And after we have explained this matter to you, know that this attribute is called in the Song of Songs Kallah [Bride]. And the secret is: "as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland, and as a bride [kallah] adorns herself with her jewels," "Come with me from Lebanon, my bride [kallah]," and "He is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber."

And know and understand that this attribute is called everywhere the Oral Torah [Torah she-be'al peh], because she is the mate of the Written Torah [Torah she-bi-chtav]. And for this reason, it is called among those who know [the mysteries] the secret of the Moon [ha-levanah]. And the reason for these two matters is identical, because the moon has no light of its own except from the sun, and the Oral Torah has no foundation except from the Written Torah. Therefore, the Oral Torah was not given at Sinai to be written down, so as not to fix a place for it except upon the Written Torah, because of the secret of the kiss, and this is the secret of the reason for: "Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth." And it was written down afterward as a decree, lest the Torah be forgotten from Israel due to the persecutions [ha-shmadot].

And behold, I am hinting at the beginning and the end: that everywhere, "speech" [dibbur] is the secret of the Written Torah, and "saying" [amirah] is the secret of the Oral Torah. This is what is stated throughout the entire Torah: "And YHWH spoke [vayidabber] unto Moses, saying [lemor]"—this one is grasped in that one, and this one requires the Gates of Righteousness within that one, and this one does not separate from that one. And he who reads the Scripture without Mishnah and Talmud is like one who has no God, and "a whisperer separates a chief friend." "And God spoke [vayidabber] unto Moses, and said [vayomer] unto him: I am YHWH." And this is what is called everywhere—Atarah [the Crown/Diadem], and the sign in the Torah is: "And you shall be a crown [atert] of beauty in the hand of YHWH," "with the crown wherewith his mother crowned him in the day of his espousals." And he who understands "you shall not take the dam [the mother] with the young [the children]" will understand the secret of "with the crown wherewith his mother crowned him," and this is the unity "in the day of his espousals"—certainly.

And sometimes it is called—Tzedek [Righteousness], and the secret is lower Righteousness and upper Righteousness: "Righteousness, righteousness shall you pursue, that you may live, and inherit the land." And because it is the court of law below, and it is that which justifies the place, it is written: "Righteousness lodged in it, but now murderers"—either this one or that one. "As for me, in righteousness I shall behold Your face," for the lower Righteousness is called "back parts" [achorayim], and certainly there is an upper Righteousness which is called "face" [panim]. And Moses did not arrive at the attainment of His face, because it is the secret of the attainment of the Upper Face.

And this attribute is called Jerusalem, for Zion and Jerusalem are the secret of Foundation [Yesod] and Kingship [Malchut]; the City of David is Zion. And there is no sitting in the Temple Courtyard except for the kings of the House of David alone. And the Scripture proclaims and says: "Blessed be YHWH out of Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem," because it is the gate of heaven.

And this attribute is called—Nesher [Eagle]. Because when she is unified with Israel, and they are righteous and upright, lovers of the Most High, then this attribute, which is their portion, renews herself like the renewal of the moon. And concerning her it is written: "so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s." But if, Heaven forbid, Israel transgressed the Torah, changed the ordinance, and broke the everlasting covenant, then this attribute is plucked and stripped, and upon her [the feathers] fall away [noshring]; and she is called Nesher [Eagle], certainly. And everywhere this attribute is called Bat Sheva [the Daughter of Seven], and she is the mate of David. And the reason is because from the Sefirah of Binah [Understanding] she draws down and nurses, by way of the six middle Sefirot, and the sign is: "For in six days YHWH made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day He rested, and was refreshed." And they said in Bereishit Rabbah: "Since [the Sabbath] has no mate, He said to her: 'The Assembly of Israel shall be your mate.'" And this is the secret of David and Bathsheba; therefore David merited kingship. And they [the Sages] said: "Bathsheba was fitting for David from the six days of Creation, but he enjoyed her as an unripened fruit [prior to the proper time]." From the "six" [Sefirot], certainly. And behold, this attribute is called—Eretz Chemdah [A Coveted/Desirable Land]. And the reason is, when the true and complete unity exists, it is found on the Sabbath through "Remember" [Zachor] and "Keep" [Shamor], in the secret of: "You shall fear every man his mother and his father, and keep My sabbaths." And likewise He says: "And God finished on the seventh day," and the Targum of Jonathan [translates]: "and coveted [the Sabbath], the most desirable of days did You call it." "And the tree was desirable to make one wise," with good understanding and grace.

And sometimes she is called—HaAretz HaTovah [The Good Land]. That is to say, when the attribute called "Good" [Tovah] dwells within her, she is called after his name "Good." And likewise He says: "the light, that it was good [tov]; and God divided, etc." When the light is within her—which is good—she is called good. Also: "YHWH shall give that which is good [hatov], and our land shall yield her increase." And likewise to Saul: "and has given it to a neighbor of yours, who is better [hatov] than you." And she is called Orah [Light], and when the light—which is good—is not within her, she is called Choshech [Darkness] and she is called Laylah [Night]. And likewise He says: "She weeps sorely in the night [balaylah]." And sometimes this attribute is called Eretz Rechavah [A Broad Land]. And the reason is, when she nurses in full measure from the broad ways of the River [Rechovot HaNahar]—which is the eighth attribute above her—she then expands and goes onward. And the sign is: "And it was broader and wound about higher up." And this is the secret of: "They stood crowded together, yet prostrated themselves with wide spaces," "There shall yet old men and old women sit in the broad places [berechovot] of Jerusalem," "Enlarge the place of your tent." And contemplate this great principle: that this Sefirah is called in several places after the name of the attribute from which she is nursing at that moment. And understand this very well, for it is a great necessity for you in several places.

And sometimes she is called—Eretz Yeveshah [A Dry Land]. That is to say, when Israel slackens their hands from the commandments, and the attributes of the Good withdraw from her, she too is then found lacking. For on account of transgression and the neglect of the commandments, the channels are broken and the flows are cut off, because transgressions break the channels. And likewise He says: "Go, get down; for your people... have dealt corruptly," "he is a companion to a destroyer," and "he spilled it on the ground [corrupted it earthward]." And by the neglect of the commandments, the flows are cut off. And likewise He says: "Wherefore is the land perished and burnt up like a wilderness... because they have forsaken My Torah, etc." And likewise He says: "My soul thirsts for You, my flesh longs for You [in a dry and weary land]." And for this reason He said in the Torah: "If you walk in My statutes... then I will give your rains in their season, and the land shall yield her increase." That is to say, when you perform the commandments, you rectify the channels and the pools draw down from the Infinite [Ein Sof], and thus upper and lower beings are blessed, as it is said: "He who blesses himself in the earth shall bless himself by the God of truth [Amen]." But if, Heaven forbid, they transgressed the Torah, what is written? "And if you shall reject My statutes, etc., I also will do this unto you... and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass." And for this reason, this attribute is sometimes called Yeveshah [Dry Land]—that is to say, when the tablets were broken and the channels were severed, the pools and flows ceased. And behold, I am hinting: "And God called the dry land [yeveshah] Earth," and it is written: "And God saw the children of Israel, and God knew." This seeing is the secret of the visitation [pekindah].

And sometimes this attribute is called—Yam [Sea]. And this is when all the channels and the flows go toward her in a rush from the depth of the Infinite [Ein Sof], and this is the secret of: "All the rivers run into the sea." But nevertheless: "yet the sea is not full," because she is the mirror that does not illuminate, and she requires illumination from the side of the Foundation [Yesod], just as we hinted regarding the verse: "Blessed be YHWH out of Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem." And this is the secret of: "And God called the dry land Earth, and the gathering together of the waters called He Seas [Yamim]." And this is the secret of the fullness of the moon, and the increase of the waters corresponds to the increase of the moon, and its deficiency corresponds to the deficiency of the moon; for when the Assembly of Israel is flowed upon, filled, and moistened, then through her blessing all creations—upper and lower—are blessed.

And this attribute is called in the Torah—Chodesh [Month / New Moon], and the sign is: "This is the burnt-offering of every month in its month [chodesh b'chodsho]"—a burnt-offering [olat, which also means 'ascending'], certainly. And the reason for the male goats of the New Moons, concerning which it said: "for a sin-offering unto YHWH," and this is the secret of the blemish of the moon and its fullness, and the secret of the moon’s complaint against the sun, and the reason: "Two kings cannot serve with one crown." And behold, I am hinting: were they both to serve with one crown, there would be no offspring in this world, and this is the reason for [the divine command]: "Go and diminish yourself." And he who knows this reason knows what the reason was that the luminaries were hung on the fourth day—at first, "the two great luminaries," and ultimately, "the greater luminary to rule the day, and the lesser luminary, etc." And therefore, the operation of the sun and the moon upon the lower beings is by the word of the Name; and this is the reason for: "And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth, and to rule over the day and over the night," and the secret of: "And for the precious things of the fruits of the sun, and for the precious things of the growth of the moons." And for this reason, the Sabbath belongs to the sun and the Festivals belong to the moon, and the great secret: "O give thanks unto YHWH, for He is good... O give thanks unto the God of gods... O give thanks to the Lord of lords." And this is the secret of: "from one month to another [mi-dei chodesh b'chodsho], and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come." He who knows this reason knows the secret of the Sanctification of the Month according to the Great Court and according to the Small Court, and the sign is Peretz and Zerach. And the core principle: "Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold," and the secret of "sevenfold" is forty-nine gates, and forty-nine days until the Giving of the Torah, and forty-nine years until the Jubilee, and then "you shall grant a redemption for the land," "he shall have redemption, and in the jubilee it shall go out." And he who understands the great reasons we have hinted at here will understand the secret of [the relationship] between the upper whiteness and the lower whiteness: "fair as the moon, clear as the sun," and the secret of: "He appointed the moon for seasons," and the secret of: "Your navel is like a round goblet [agan hasahar, also 'the crescent basin'] wherein mixed wine is not wanting."

And sometimes this attribute is called—Acharit [End / Latter Time]. And the reason is because she is the end of the Sefirot, and the sign is: "and you shall see my back parts [achorai]." And he who understands this reason will understand: "And it shall come to pass in the end of days [be-acharit ha-yamim], that the mountain of the Lord’s house shall be established as the top of the mountains," and understand the great insight that at the end it is written: "For out of Zion shall go forth the Torah." And this is the core of the redemption and the hope for Israel. And because the Shechinah is always with Israel, both in the land and outside the land, it is written: "Who dwells with them in the midst of their uncleanness." And this is what Rabbi Shimon bar Yochai said: "Precious are Israel, for in every place they were exiled, the Shechinah went into exile with them. They were exiled to Egypt, the Shechinah was with them; they were exiled to Babylon, the Shechinah was with them." And he who understands the secret of the exile of Egypt will understand the secret of: "And I will pass through the land of Egypt," and He did not say, "And I will go down." "A king is held captive in the tresses." And at Mount Sinai He said to Moses: "And YHWH descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed," and afterward: "And YHWH passed by before him, and proclaimed." And because the Shechinah is with Israel, if they are righteous, behold, she is "a joyful mother of children," and it is written: "Let your father and your mother be glad, and let her that bore you rejoice." But if, Heaven forbid, Israel sins, it is "a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bore him," and it is written: "A wise son makes a glad father, but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother." And they [the Sages] have already hinted at an analogy: to a child who soils his garments, where the king said, "Let his nurse come and wipe away the filth." And the secret is: "and for your transgressions was your mother put away." And because the Assembly of Israel endures the soiling that Israel causes, what is written in the Torah? "In your distress, when all these things are come upon you, in the end of days [be-acharit ha-yamim]..." and therefore: "...you shall return to YHWH your God."

And behold, I am opening for you the gates of light [sha'arei orah]: know that because this attribute is called Acharit [End], we are destined to return to Zion by way of repentance. And behold, I am hinting: the attribute called Acharit is cleaved to the middle line by means of the hope of the scarlet thread [literally, tikvat chut hashani]. And the Scripture proclaims and says: "And there is hope [tikvah] for your future [le-acharitech], says YHWH, and the children shall return to their own border." By virtue of the hope that is bound up with the End, it is bound up with Israel; and therefore, "and the children shall return to their own border." And every expression of hope [tikvah] is a language of a line [kav, from kavah], and likewise it hints by way of the inner Foundation [Yesod] in the building of Ezekiel: "and a line [kav] of thirty cubits," and it is written kaveh [with a hei]. And it is written in the prophecies of the latter times: "and a line [kav] shall be stretched forth over Jerusalem." And he who understands these great principles will understand the secret of Tikvah [Hope / Measuring Line] in every place. And by means of the hope, we shall return unto the middle line, "and a line shall be stretched forth over Jerusalem."

And this attribute is sometimes called—Aron HaBrit [the Ark of the Covenant]. He who knows this secret knows the secret of the Tablets that are placed within the Ark. And this is the secret of: "Behold, the ark of the covenant, the Lord [Adon] of all the earth." This [attribute, Malchut] is called ADNY, and Foundation [Yesod] is certainly called "the Lord of all the earth." When the Tablets are inside the Ark, the Shechinah dwells among Israel as an eternal inheritance. In every place they walk, they are the inheritance of the Place [God], and they can never be separated from Him; there is no bill of divorcement [get keritut] there. This is the secret of: "Where is the bill of your mother’s divorcement, wherewith I have put her away?" And if you should say, "But behold, it is written afterward: 'And I saw, when, forasmuch as backsliding Israel had committed adultery, I had put her away and given her a bill of divorcement'?" Heaven forbid! That refers to the Kingdom of Jeroboam [the Northern Kingdom], which has no return, and likewise the Kingdom of Samaria. But Judah—which is the secret of the Assembly of Israel, where the Shechinah dwells in Jerusalem and in Judah through David—concerning this, the verse proclaims: "yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not; but she also went and played the harlot." And this is the secret of: "Where is the bill of your mother’s divorcement, etc." Guard this very great principle! By means of Judah, Samaria will return, but it will not return to kingship, because the Name gave it a bill of divorcement regarding the kingship. And this is the secret of: "And I will make them one nation in the land, upon the mountains of Israel, and one king shall be king to them all; and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all... and My servant David shall be king over them, and they all shall have one shepherd." Understand this very well! The reason is because the writ that the Lord wrote to the Assembly of Israel was given to the kings of Judah, who guard it in the Holy of Holies. And by means of Israel—who received the Torah and the Tablets and placed them into the Ark—the nine Sefirot became bound to the tenth, through the secret of the Tablets placed within the Ark that Israel made. Therefore, through Israel, all the Sefirot became unified. Were they not to receive the Torah from below, the Sefirot would have no unity from above, because the place of the Shechinah was in that land. This is what they said in Bereishit Rabbah: "The essential dwelling of the Shechinah was among the lower beings." And if the middle line no longer stretches downward to reach the place of the Shechinah, there is no longer any unity there at all; for when the Shechinah is not in her proper place below, there is no true unity. Behold, when the world was created, the line of Tiferet [Beauty] from above drew abundance downward to the place of the Shechinah, and then the heavens and the earth were grasped together. This is the secret of: "And the heaven and the earth were finished [vayechullu], and all the host of them," from the language of bridegroom and bride [chatan ve-kallah], which the Targum translates as ve-ishtachlalu [were perfected/adorned]. That is to say, the lower beings became a Chariot for the upper beings, entering into one another and joining together. At that time, the Lord, blessed be He, was One in the world in perfection. But when the first man came and corrupted the forms, the Shechinah withdrew, the bundle was separated, and the ruins of the world were found—until Israel came and received the Written Torah (which is the secret of the middle line), drew her down, and fashioned the Ark as a counterpart to the Shechinah. Thus, by means of Israel, "YHWH is One and His name One." This is the secret of "YHWH is One," and it is written: "And who is like Your people Israel, a nation one in the earth?" And this is the secret of: "And what will You do for Your great name?"—as it were, by means of Israel, YHWH is made One. The secret lies in the two Tablets placed in the Ark. He who understands this secret will understand how great the capacity to receive the Torah was. And the secret: "You did cause sentence to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still," and it is written: "The heaven is My throne, and the earth is My footstool," and it is written: "and I will make the place of My feet glorious." He who understands these great, fundamental matters that we have hinted at will understand the reason for: "Your name is called upon Your city and upon Your people," and the secret of: "you shall call Me 'My husband' [Ishi], and shall call Me no more 'My master' [Ba'ali], etc.," and the secret of: "And I will betroth you unto Me in righteousness [be-tzedek], etc.," and the secret of: "For YHWH your God is in your midst," and the secret of: "I will not enter into your midst"—literally in your midst—and the secret of: "The Holy One in your midst; and I will not enter into the city." Regarding what the Sages said: "I will not enter the heavenly Jerusalem until I enter the earthly Jerusalem"—he who understands this will understand the secret of the hiding of the Ark, and the secret of: "And I will bring your sanctuaries unto desolation." And as our Sages, of blessed memory, said: "Even though they are desolate, they still stand in their holiness before Him." The explanation is that the Ark, the Covenant, the Lord of all the earth, and the Tablets are hidden there. This is the secret of "the Lord of all the Covenant, the Lord of all the earth." Everything is hinted at and clarified for the one to whom the Name, blessed be He, has granted knowledge.

And sometimes this attribute is called—Elohim. And behold, I am hinting: the eighth attribute is written YHWH but read as Elohim, which is the secret of the might [Gevurah] of YHWH, and she is the one that draws down the judgments below. From her is emanated the attribute of Gevurah, which is called everywhere Elohim. And he who understands the secret of Elohim will understand the secret of "In the beginning Elohim created"—which "beginning" [Reshit]? It is spoken of in the sense of "Elohim of Hosts" [Elohim Tzevaot], and from Gevurah the attribute of judgment is emanated to Hod [Splendor], and concerning this it is said: Elohim Tzevaot. When all the upper Sefirot are integrated from the side of Chesed [Lovingkindness] and empty into the tenth Sefirah, it is called YHWH. But when the attribute of judgment and Gevurah are integrated and empty into her, she too is called Elohim, in accordance with the expression: "for My name is in his midst." And these matters are exceedingly deep; from them you will enter the secret of what the Torah said, "In the beginning Elohim created," for the word "In the beginning" [Bereishit] includes all types of "beginning," each according to its context, and the word Elohim in the verse of Bereishit also includes every name Elohim mentioned in the Torah, each according to its context. When the Torah says "In the beginning [He] created," it hints at the expansion of Binah [Understanding] from Chachmah [Wisdom], for from there the name Elohim begins in the world of judgment. Behold, Binah is the beginning [Reshit] of the seven Sefirot, and it hints at the creation of the world of angels and all other worlds and kingdoms called Reshit, and she is called Elohim. When you understand this, you will merit to understand all that our Sages, of blessed memory, expounded upon the word Bereishit, when they said: "There is no Reshit but Wisdom [Chachmah].", "There is no Reshit but the Torah.", "There is no Reshit but Israel." ...and all other things that are called Reshit. And you will understand what was said, that for the sake of Moses the world was created, as it is said: "And he chose a first part [Reshit] for himself, for there a portion of a ruler was hidden," and everything is hidden within the treasures of the Torah. Everything is clarified for the one who has eyes to see, for from the revealed matters those with eyes will enter into the hidden mysteries, and the sign is: "A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver, etc." If so, contemplate this: at the time the attribute of Malchut [Kingship] is called Elohim, it is because the attribute of Malchut is filled from Gevurah. The bottom line is that in every place, she is called after the name of the thing by which she is filled, and the sign is: "the tree of the knowledge of good and evil." And you, guard this great principle for every place in the Torah: that this attribute is named after the thing she receives from, because "My name is in his midst." Therefore, when Israel is pure and righteous, they fill that mirror above her, all of which are the channels of the 613 commandments. But if, Heaven forbid, Israel turns from the straight path, sins, and defiles the world, she then becomes filled with those external forces, which are the forms of the transgressions. Then she is called "a sword filled with blood," and it is written: "I was full of justice; righteousness lodged in it, but now murderers." The bottom line is that she is never empty: she is either "full of justice" or "murderers." And this is what our Sages, of blessed memory, said: "From the day the Temple was destroyed, even though the four types of death-penalties were abolished, their judgments were not abolished." What is the reason? It is either "justice" or "murderers." Guard this principle! From it you will be able to grasp how great the power is of one who fulfills commandments, purifies the world, merits and brings merit to the masses, and guides them in a straight path; or conversely, those who commit a transgression, defile the world, sin and cause others to sin—to what extent the power of their wickedness reaches, for they have sinned and blemished the Assembly of Israel. And this is: "a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bore him," "A wise son makes a glad father, but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother," "and for your transgressions was your mother put away." And the secret: "My son, if your heart be wise, my heart will be glad, even mine," and the secret of: "and he caused a throne to be set for the king’s mother." Guard this principle regarding what is written: "a joyful mother of children," and the secret of: "Let your father and your mother be glad, and let her that bore you rejoice." And after we have explained to you these great principles, know that this attribute is also called Shaddai. The reason is because from her comes the abundance to all existences in the world, and she is the one who sustains all creations. From her, every creature receives strength, existence, establishment, life, and sustenance, because she is the gate to all the Sefirot, and there is no way for any aspect in the world to receive anything from the rest of the Sefirot except through her. And the secret: "And a river went out of Eden to water the garden"—up to the garden [Gan] is the place of abundance, emanation, and nursing, and from there downward is the world of separation [olam ha-perud]. Thus, from Malchut downward, all creations separate into their various kinds, and they receive abundance and strength, each and every one according to the types of recipients from the attribute of Malchut. Each one receives joy, existence, and life from her, "every man according to his eating" and according to his kind. Therefore, this attribute is called Shaddai, because there is in her enough [Dai] sustenance, life, existence, and establishment for all existences in the world, and nothing is lacking in her, and all nurse from her. This is what they said in tractate Chagigah regarding the name Shaddai: "He who said to the world, 'Enough!' [Dai]"—that is to say, in this attribute there is enough, rectification, establishment, and existence for all existences, for each one according to its context. And this is the attribute through which the prophets would prophesy by way of rectification. When Israel does the will of the Place [God], all the channels come from above to her in a complete fullness, and the pools flow into Israel first, and from there onward the pools are drawn down to the rest of all the creations and existences in the world, each according to its kind. The analogy is the matter of the breasts [shadayim] from which an infant nurses. But if, Heaven forbid, they sin and provoke anger, then the channels are cut off from above, and no blessing is found among creations. And the secret: "We have a little sister, and she has no breasts [shadayim]; what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for? If she be a wall, we will build upon her a turret of silver—from the upper whiteness—and if she be a door [or dalah, meaning poor/impoverished], we will enclose her with boards of cedar." And it says: "I am a wall, and my breasts [shadayim] like towers"—I am strong in the commandments, and my breasts are like towers, like banner-bearing hosts—"then was I in his eyes as one that found peace." Everything is hinted at in this verse. But if, Heaven forbid, Israel defiled the Sanctuary and the Palace, and brought into it the forces of impurity, then within the attribute called Shaddai they bring in those forces of impurity which are called demons [shedim]: "from the destruction [ketev] that wastes [yashud] at noonday," "The tents of robbers prosper [literally, yishlayu ohalim la-shodedim]." Woe to that hour! For that is the defilement of the Sanctuary: "The kings of the earth believed not, neither all the inhabitants of the world, that the adversary and the enemy would enter into the gates of Jerusalem," "there shall no more come into you the uncircumcised and the unclean," and "and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land." Contemplate this: the unclean spirit and the shedim [demons] are called spirits [ruchot], just as is said in Chagigah and in several places. And the secret: "Alas! for the day of YHWH is at hand, and as a destruction from the Almighty [ke-shod mi-Shaddai] shall it come." The bottom line is, when the nursing of the letter Yod is cut off from Shaddai, she becomes destroyed [shedudah]. Therefore, she is called a mirror that does not illuminate—meaning from herself, but rather from the abundance that comes to her from the channels. Behold, at the time she is filled, she is called Shaddai, and there is in her enough [Dai] for the whole world; but if, Heaven forbid, the channels are cut off, then destruction [shod] is found. Therefore, she is called a mirror that does not illuminate from herself, but rather by means of the letter Yod when she is called Shaddai. Behold, all the prophets did not enter inside her, but only reached as far as the gatehouse. She was the veil [Parochet] up to which the prophets reached, and behind her they would see what they saw, and they would hear the voice of YHWH of Hosts, blessed be He, in the vision of prophecy. Therefore, matters were not fully clear to them, because she is a barrier standing before them. This is the secret of "the mirrors of the serving women who served [hatzove'ot] at the door of the tent of meeting," and concerning this it is said: "Hear now My words: If there be a prophet among you, I YHWH will make Myself known unto him in a vision, I will speak with him in a dream." But Moses our teacher, peace be upon him, entered inside her, and attained within the polished mirror, for he entered inward from the mirror that is not polished. What is written concerning Abraham? "And YHWH appeared unto him by the terebinths of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day." But regarding Moses it is written: "And He called unto Moses, and YHWH spoke unto him out of the tent of meeting, saying." Therefore, the prophecy of Moses is separated from all the prophets, for all the prophets saw from the door of the tent, but Moses saw from within the tent. And this is what He said: "Hear now My words: If there be a prophet among you, I YHWH will make Myself known unto him in a vision, I will speak with him in a dream. My servant Moses is not so; he is trusted in all My house." And you already know that the house of Tiferet [Beauty] is Shaddai, and it is the Tent of Meeting. Therefore, the Scripture said to Moses: "And I appeared unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, as God Almighty [El Shaddai]; but by My name YHWH I was not known to them." Did they see My name YHWH from within El Shaddai and from within the mirror that is not polished? Therefore, "I was not known to them" with ultimate clarity, for they did not attain My truth except from behind the veil, and the secret is: the pillars with the sockets. He who understands this secret of what we have explained regarding the attribute of Shaddai will understand the secret of: "Can you by searching find out God? Can you find out the Almighty [Shaddai] unto perfection?" This is the secret of "And I appeared unto Abraham... and My name YHWH, etc." Open your eyes and see wonders; if you merit, you shall see.

And this attribute is sometimes called—Mitah [Bed/Couch]. And the reason is: "Behold, it is the couch [mitato] of Solomon; threescore mighty men are about it, of the mighty men of Israel," because surrounding her are all kinds of accusers and destroyers in the world, and several kinds of destruction and retribution surround her. And the sign is: "As a lily among thorns," for "this is Jerusalem, in the midst of the nations I have set her, and countries are round about her." And if, Heaven forbid, the center tilts slightly—that is to say, away from the Tree of Life in the midst of the garden—behold, her leaves are caught in the thorns and torn apart. But at the time when Israel is worthy and whole, and they offer peace-offerings properly, then the verse is fulfilled: "And I will give peace in the land," and then the couch of Solomon was certainly complete.

And know that this couch [Mitah] is the inheritance of Jacob our father, peace be upon him, completely and above all, because he was a perfect firstborn, as it is said: "Israel is My son, My firstborn." Therefore, Jacob inherited this couch, whereas Abraham did not inherit it because there was in him the blemish of Ishmael, and Isaac did not inherit it because there was in him the blemish of Esau. For the thorns and briers around the couch are Esau, along with the rest of the external forces and the guardian angels of the nations. But Jacob, who is complete and stands in the center [the middle line], inherited this couch, as it is said: "Israel is My son, My firstborn." Consequently, this couch returned to him as it was at the beginning of the creation of the world, and therefore: "And Israel bowed upon the bed's head [vayashtachu Yisrael al rosh ha-mitah]." What is the reason? It is written: "In Salem also is His tabernacle [sukko, meaning his cover/booth]," and it is written: "And Jacob was a wholesome [tam] man, dwelling in tents," which the Targum translates as gvar shlim [a complete/perfect man]. Therefore: "Behold, it is the couch of Solomon." And if you should say: regarding Abraham it is written, "and be you wholehearted [tamim]," which the Targum translates as v'hvei shlim—[note that] "walk before Me" is written concerning him, meaning by way of walking and not by way of sitting, for he did not sit upon the Throne of YHWH. But regarding Jacob it is written, "a wholesome man, dwelling [sitting] in tents"—by way of sitting, for Jacob sat upon the Throne of YHWH. And the sign is: "Israel, in whom I will be glorified," "like the beauty of a man, to dwell in a house." Therefore it is written of him, "a wholesome man, dwelling in tents," certainly—"This is the Torah: when a man dies in a tent." Therefore, he [Jacob] said: "Heaven forbid, is there any defect in my couch, as occurred with Abraham, from whom issued Ishmael, or like Isaac, from whom issued Esau?" They all answered and said: "Hear, O Israel: YHWH our God, YHWH is One." Thus, his couch was found to be complete. For this reason, at the time of his passing, he cleaved to it entirely, and this is: "And he gathered up his feet into the bed [ha-mitah], and expired, and was gathered unto his people." In every place regarding the righteous, "gathering" [asifah] refers to the place of the couch, which is the place of purity. For outside of this couch, all are places of impurity on the outer sides. Therefore: "If there be among you any man, that is not clean by reason of that which chances him by night, then shall he go abroad outside the camp, he shall not come within the camp." And it is written: "that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that has an issue." And regarding Miriam it is written: "Let her be shut up without the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in [te'asef, gathered] again." Open your eyes and see wonders! And regarding Naaman it is written: "and you shall recover him [ve-asafto, gather him] of his leprosy." And the great secret: "that the righteous is taken away [ne'esaf, gathered] from the evil to come," "Gather [isfu] My godly ones together unto Me," and "and men of piety are taken away [ne'esafim]." He who understands this secret knows the mystery of "And he gathered up his feet into the bed, etc." Therefore, every person must be careful at the time of their death that nothing of their limbs remains outside of this couch; for regarding anyone of whom there remains anything outside of this couch, it is said: "they shall not be gathered [lo ye'asef], nor be buried; I have given you for food to the beasts of the field and to the fowls of the heaven." For surrounding this couch are all kinds of destroyers and retributions, and whatever remains of a man's limbs outside of this couch dies in great torment. And this is the secret of what we said: "Behold, it is the couch of Solomon; threescore mighty men are about it, of the mighty men of Israel. They all handle the sword, and are expert in war; every man has his sword upon his thigh, because of fear in the night"—that is to say, because of the fear of Gehenna, which resembles the night. Therefore, it is written of Jacob: "And he gathered up his feet into the bed." For this reason, every person needs to prepare themselves for "gathering," for were it not for this, one would be in great torment. Contemplate the great principles we have opened for you in this place, and from there you will see many wondrous secrets. As we have said: "There is nothing between the Garden of Eden and Gehenna but a hair's breadth," and the sign is: "and it shall be very tempestuous [nis'arah, related to sa'arah, hair] round about Him." Therefore, a man must ensure he does not remain outside, but rather is "gathered unto his people." And by virtue of this reason, you will understand every type of "gathering" [asifah] that is stated in this context regarding the righteous.

And this attribute is called Yam Suf [the Reed Sea / Red Sea]. Therefore, it was ready to receive her children and rescue them from the hand of His enemies. Did I not tell you that surrounding the couch are briers, thorns, and briars? Behold, the land of Egypt is the "second land" to the Land of Israel. Therefore, it is called Mitzrayim [Egypt]—which is from the language of meitzar [a narrow strait/borderland] adjacent to the inheritance, for the strait divides the boundaries. And behold, the Scripture proclaims: "Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt," meaning it was joined together (chubar yachdav)—built seven years, which is Bat Sheva [the Daughter of Seven, Malchut], and Zoan in Egypt is adjacent to her. And this is why they said that the land of Egypt is second to the Land of Israel, for the guardian angel of Egypt is second in the Chariot: "And he made him to ride in the second chariot [mirkavat hamishneh] which he had." Therefore, the Name, blessed be He, needed to perform signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, because its guardian angel is a supreme prince over all the princes, Egypt being second to the Land of Israel, as in: "like the garden of YHWH, like the land of Egypt." Therefore, YHWH, blessed be He, placed signs and wonders upon that great prince, the prince of Egypt, so that they would not say, "There is a great prince in the heights whom YHWH, blessed be He, cannot overcome." Therefore: "Smite the capital, that the posts may shake." Therefore, the Torah said: "that you may remember the day when you came forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life," so that we may be confident that there is no prince or ruler among all the nations whom the Holy One, blessed be He, cannot overcome. And it is written: "and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgments." Therefore, YHWH, blessed be He, Himself executed judgments against all the gods of Egypt, for there is no prince or ruler who can withstand Him, but the Name alone. And therefore: "And I will pass through the land of Egypt"—"I, and not an angel"; "and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgments"—"I, and not a messenger." Consequently, He smote the firstborn, and smote the constellation of Aries (Taleh), which is the head of the twelve constellations, and smote in Nisan, which is the head of the twelve months, as it is written: "Observe the month of Abib," meaning Av [the father/head] of the twelve. Behold, Egypt—the strait adjacent to the Land of Israel—pursued Israel until they reached Yam Suf. When they reached that place, that attribute called Yam Suf received them, which is the secret of the Sea [Yam] called Suf [the End] of the levels within the Ten Sefirot. And the secret is: "And I will set your border from the Red Sea [Yam Suf] even unto the sea of the Philistines." Open your eyes and see! Therefore, this attribute is called Sufah [Storm/Whirlwind], as it is written: "YHWH has His way in the whirlwind [ba-sufah] and in the storm." A great secret is hinted at here: Sufah is the end (sof) of the Ten Sefirot, and adjacent to it is the storm (se'arah), the place where the boundaries are divided. And the sign is: "and it shall be very tempestuous [nis'arah] round about Him," "Then YHWH answered Job out of the whirlwind [min ha-se'arah]," "He breaketh me with a tempest [be-se'arah]," and "and shall go with whirlwinds [be-sa'arot] of the south." Therefore: "in the whirlwind [ba-sufah] and in the storm [u-ve-se'arah] is His way." And this is what our Sages, of blessed memory, said: "The Holy One, blessed be He, is exacting with the righteous even to a hair's breadth [ke-chut ha-se'arah]," because surrounding the righteous is the secret of the hair [se'arah], and the sign is: "and his hand took hold on Esau’s heel," and he is hairy (se'ir), and it is the place where boundaries divide. "And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto the satyrs [la-se'irim]." For when the attribute of Sufah passes, it inspects every place; it finds "the hairy scalp [kodkod se'ar] of such a one as goeth on still in his guiltiness." And when it finds the wicked, it consumes them from the world. And the secret is: "When the whirlwind [sufah] passeth, the wicked is no more; but the righteous is an everlasting foundation," for "behold, YHWH will come with fire, and His chariots shall be like the whirlwind [ka-sufah], to render His anger with fury, and His rebuke with flames of fire." Therefore, you will find at the Exodus from Egypt that the Egyptians pursued Israel until the Yam Suf, and at Yam Suf the miracle was performed for them, for it is the place of miracles. There He exacted punishment from the Egyptians and performed the miracle for Israel: "Your right hand, O YHWH, glorious in power, Your right hand, O YHWH, dashes in pieces the enemy." His right hand submerges them and rescues you. The reason she is called Sufah is because she has a front and a back within a single attribute: from within, mercy; from without, retribution. And so it is destined to be with Edom at the time of the redemption, which will come to consume the hair (se'ar) surrounding her—for that is Edom, who is Seir. From that time onward, "He will shave the hairy scalp above, etc.," and nothing of their power below will remain for them: "YHWH will punish the host of the high heaven on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth, etc.," "Who is this that cometh from Edom, etc." And then it is written: "Enlarge the place of your tent," and "In that day shall YHWH shave with a razor that is hired," and it is written: "But God shall smite through the head of His enemies, the hairy scalp [kodkod se'ar] of such a one as goeth on still in his guiltiness." And when no hair (se'ar) remains on Seir, then: "And saviors shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be YHWH's," and then: "And YHWH shall be King over all the earth." This is the secret of: "YHWH will have war with Amalek," and "Who is this that cometh from Edom." Just as the war of Egypt was with a nation bordering the Land of Israel, so the future war of Seir will be with a nation bordering the Land of Israel. It is written: "your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin close by the side of Edom," and this is the secret of: "and his hand took hold on Esau’s heel." Therefore: "According to the days of your coming forth out of the land of Egypt will I show unto him marvelous things." Then He will shave the hairy scalp of Seir, "his mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violence shall come down upon his own scalp." Therefore, it says concerning the final redemption: "For, behold, YHWH will come with fire, and His chariots shall be like the whirlwind [ka-sufah], to render His anger with fury, and His rebuke with flames of fire." And adjacent to it: "For by fire will YHWH plead, and by His sword, with all flesh," and this is: "For My sword hath drunk its fill in heaven; behold, it shall come down upon Edom," and "The sword of YHWH is filled with blood," and "Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments... wherefore is Your apparel red?" Behold, wondrous secrets regarding the boundaries of the Land of Israel have been clarified for you, and all of them are destined to be consumed. And then: "And when YHWH your God shall enlarge your border, etc.," "Enlarge the place of your tent," and then: "And YHWH shall be King over all the earth." From this place, you will understand the secret of the two male goats on the Day of Atonement: "And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land which is cut off [eretz gizerah]... and he shall let the goat go in the wilderness." And "your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin close by the side of Edom," and "but Jacob I loved, and Esau I hated, and I made his mountains a desolation, and gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness." Here is the secret of what our Sages, of blessed memory, said: "The Name, blessed be He, is exacting with the righteous even to a hair's breadth," because Seir shares a border with the attribute called Tzedek [Righteousness]. Therefore, Jacob and Esau were born as one. Therefore it is written: "You are to pass through the border of your brethren the children of Esau, that dwell in Seir; and they will be afraid of you; take good heed unto yourselves therefore; contend not with them; for I will not give you of their land... because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession." The reason is that YHWH, blessed be He, left them to rule over Israel with them, and to be exacting with them to a hair's breadth—"and it shall be very tempestuous [nis'arah] round about Him." And: "Now these are the nations which YHWH left, to prove Israel by them." But at the end of all things: "And saviors shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be YHWH's." "Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest be set among the stars, I will bring you down from thence, saith YHWH." Behold, we have explained to you great principles regarding the matter of Yam Suf and the matter of Sufah. Guard them, for they are hidden in several places in the Torah, and the sign is: "Wherefore it is said in the book of the Wars of YHWH: Vaheb in Sufah [be-sufah], and the valleys of Arnon." The explanation of this verse is that at Yam Suf were the wars of YHWH, and in the valleys of Arnon is the secret of partnership (the dough-tax of arnona, the livestock of arnona). He who knows this secret knows the mystery of the fords of Arnon and the great miracles that were performed in them. And Arnon is the secret of the borderland place between Moab and Israel, as it is written: "for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites," and Israel inherited the Amorites, as it is written: "And Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites." Therefore: "and the valleys of Arnon"—that is to say, the war that Malchut fought at Yam Suf is called by this name, and the fords of Arnon are called Arnon among the Amorites. She fought on behalf of Israel in all the appropriate places according to her fitting name: Yam Suf against the Egyptians, Arnon against the Amorites. And from here, you will enter the secret of "As a lily among thorns," and the secret of "this is Jerusalem, in the midst of the nations I have set her, and countries are round about her," and the secret of the "threescore mighty men about it, all handling the sword." In this manner, you will understand many hidden things from the Torah.
